experiment: not run; exact finite-binomial calculations only
scope: 64 independent fixed-seed geantino Galactic aperture batches, N=2000; no universal coverage claim
interval_definition: observed fluence +/-2*reported standard error; known true expected total fluence N/144; unavailable samples retained and reported, never resampled
method: mode-centered binomial probability recurrence, normalize by math.fsum; coverage mask uses exact Bernoulli uncorrected-event standard error; frozen before simulation
stopping: exactly these 64 seeds; no retries, extra batches, N/tolerance/seed changes after observing results; genuine execution failures retain original evidence and stop
familywise_error_note: Two preregistered tests each at 1%; union-bound false-rejection probability <=2%, not a joint 1% claim.
